mapper.select: SELECT coordi_id AS coordiId, user_id AS userId, coordi_name AS coordiName, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, ai_file_id AS aiFileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM coordis WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coordi_items ci INNER JOIN clothes c ON ci.clothes_id = c.clothes_id WHERE ci.coordi_id = coordis.coordi_id AND c.is_active = 'N' ) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT coordi_id AS coordiId, user_id AS userId, coordi_name AS coordiName, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, ai_file_id AS aiFileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM coordis WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(coordi_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM coordis WHERE SUBSTR(coordi_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')
mapper.update: UPDATE coordis SET coordi_name = #{coordiName}, description = #{description}, file_id = #{fileId}, canvas_json = #{canvasJson}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
UPDATE coordis SET ai_file_id = #{aiFileId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coordi_id = #{coordiId}
